description: Presidential Secretariat- The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) Order
categorisation: This gazette content involves the President exercising powers under the Public Security Ordinance to call out armed forces for maintaining public order. This constitutes a legal/regulatory action under existing legislation rather than a government personnel change, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories. The content focuses on the implementation of statutory powers and the issuance of a legal order.
